description: New alerts from monitoring: NEW_MATCHING_PROPERTY, NEW_STRONG_STYLE_MATCH, PRICE_DROP, RENT_DROP, PRICE_THRESHOLD_REACHED, RENT_THRESHOLD_REACHED, PROPERTY_BACK_ON_MARKET, LISTING_STATUS_CHANGED, SAVED_PROPERTY_UPDATED, INVESTMENT_CRITERIA_MATCHED. Filter by types (e.g. price changes only) or watchlist. Each alert has the property, source, previous and current values, detection time, freshness and why it matched. Returned alerts are marked retrieved. Relay the message wording; do not upgrade it (a price drop is not a bargain, a removed listing is not a sale).

types.description: Filter, e.g. ['PRICE_DROP','RENT_DROP'] for price changes or ['NEW_MATCHING_PROPERTY','NEW_STRONG_STYLE_MATCH'] for new matches.

name: get_property_alerts
title: Get property alerts
